g.title: DronePhysics
g.text: Numbered effects follow the Module 6 force inventory

g.title: air
g.text: Wind changes aerodynamic loads; not a separate force

g.title: state
g.text: Pose, velocity, body rates, ground clearance

g.title: apply
g.text: from off-center rotor thrust (do not double-apply)
Colors identify subsystem roles, not force priority or implementation status. Dashed arrows indicate dependencies or feedback.
